title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132708)
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation's MediaWiki Parsoid service due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This affects certain versions of mediawiki/services/parsoid, specifically from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages generated by the service.
